scope: Ouchi's operator-approved physical-storage share, not proof of total organization/project usage or control of other apps' writers

prototype.claims: Immutable unique physical object path + claim UUID + byte count + upload/transfer-copy purpose
prototype.accounting: Reserved/potentially written originals and transfer copies remain charged independently of logical file/owner/epoch/subscription changes. Same exact claim replay never double-charges. No timed release or release through metadata deletion.
prototype.serialization: Transaction advisory lock shared by claim insertion and operator policy changes
prototype.permissions: Private RLS tables; clients denied; service may reserve/read but cannot enable/change policy, update/delete claims, or bypass capacity via direct insertion
prototype.authorization: A capacity UUID is not Auth, entitlement, permission to write or proof that a transaction committed. Commit verified reservation before any physical Storage call; revalidate original user/session/epoch/rights separately.

localVerification.engine: PGlite disposable schema; not real concurrent PostgreSQL or Storage

providerReferences.backupBoundary: Database backups contain Storage metadata, not stored file contents; no file-backup benefit is promised.

releaseRequirements: Approve exact byte allocation against actual current organization plan and all project/app usage; do not infer spare capacity from a single metadata snapshot
Inventory and connect every Ouchi write path, pending attempt, restore and handoff copy; coordinate other apps' allocations/writers before claiming a project-wide cap
Implement verified physical-absence release with immutable path custody and no late-write resurrection; claims currently remain held forever

Before account-deletion completion, erase/minimize identifying claim paths after verified absence and late-writer fencing; this immutable prototype currently cannot prove that personal metadata erasure
Prove PostgreSQL concurrency, cross-resource lock ordering and deadline behavior before activation
Integrate capacity admission before selling a storage allowance, not merely at upload time
Confirm finite deletion/backups/service-exit timing and actual operational responsibility before publishing retention promises
noPaidChanges: No plan upgrade, spend-cap change, bucket creation, production migration/grant or customer-file deletion. Live resource observations stay in the local task report.
